paragraphs.text: Mississippi’s transportation department lists a directional median for the U.S. 278 intersection with Mississippi 342 and Black Zion Road in Pontotoc County. The work appears under November in the department’s proposed project schedule. The listing gives no date for crews to start or for traffic to change.

The department’s three-year safety plan has a separate entry for the same intersection, where U.S. 278 also carries Mississippi 6. That entry describes a restricted crossing U-turn and gives a planning estimate of $1.75 million for federal fiscal year 2027. The November median listing gives no price for the state crew’s work.

In a restricted crossing U-turn design, a driver coming from a side road first turns right onto the divided highway. To go left, the driver uses a designated opening farther along the median to turn back. To continue across, the driver makes that same U-turn and then turns right onto the continuation of the side road.

For now, MDOT identifies the median installation as state-forces work in District 1. The department says its proposed months can move as projects are revised. Drivers looking for a construction date will need a separate notice for this intersection.
